name: signature-agent-bridge
description: Local job orchestration, workflows, and a diagnostic dashboard powered by your Claude Code subscription.
long_description: The extension starts a shared local listener with durable jobs, authenticated REST/SSE, workflows, and native bypass execution through your own installed Claude Code login. Claude Code 2.1.260 or later and a subscription login are required. No API key is collected. Data stays in your operating system's user data directory.
